scope: Read-only audit of original finalizer and generated figures; no training, sampling, plotting or curated edits by reviewer.
status: Original figures need reporting-only corrections before presenting as final; root agent notified.

defects.location: series(), panel (h) dashed action_oor_frac curves in both original figures
defects.evidence: Every executed run has 14 eval rows with action_oor_frac=0. On environment-step x axes, eval iterations 10..130 overwrite the preceding training observation at the same cumulative step. On iteration axes, eval zeros are included as observations.
defects.impact: Artificial periodic drops to zero in a training-sampler diagnostic. Numeric action_oor_mean summaries already correctly restrict to training rows.
defects.minimal_fix: Filter action_oor_frac (and policy_action_oor_frac if plotted) to rows with train_episode_reward before constructing the coordinate map; state training sampler in caption.

defects.evidence: Undefined windows are removed, allowing connectors across missing values. E0 mean connects itr49 to119 across six unsupported windows. Means themselves require all three finite seeds and do not average survivors.
defects.impact: Visual continuity implies observations through undefined windows; line-only isolated points are invisible.
defects.minimal_fix: Keep a complete ordered window grid and mask undefined entries with NaN, including mean/band when any seed is undefined; show finite observations with markers and visible isolated mean±SD where supported. Keep crosses for undefined denominators.

verified_correct: Mean/SD aggregation requires all three finite comparable seed values.
Nonpositive log observations and lower bands are omitted without epsilon substitution.
Window estimator requires all nine training iterations and positive summed split-dot denominator.
BATCH4 figure uses iteration for its first row and training environment samples for its second row.
BATCH4 final evaluation step is 37,440,000 versus 9,360,000 for SGD3; final training step is 40,320,000 versus 10,080,000.
Return curves and tabulated action_oor_mean are unaffected by the two plotting defects.
readability: Original 8-column figures are dense at chat/report display size but legible when opened or zoomed as PDF. Keep a small endpoint table or answer in the study report; use figures as linked detail.

Phase 4 title mentions projection although all six projection slots were skipped. Label this explicitly or use a batch-size comparison title; caption should explain the unused projection-radius guide.

For B_env, one isolated common finite point exists in eight conditions, two points in E0, and none in E2. Point markers are necessary; absence of a continuous mean is substantive rather than an empty-plot bug.
Panel (h) must explicitly name the training sampler after filtering; raw action fraction is dimensionless on 0..1 scale.
preservation: All inspected originals remain unchanged by this reviewer. Root agent plans separate reviewed candidates, preserving original figures and curated artifacts.
